svg.title: From evidence admission to bounded assurance
svg.desc: An assertion passes interpretation, authority, status and permitted-use checks before supporting an assurance argument; action authorization remains separate. Evidence admission preserves the original assertion and checks its interpretation, issuer authority, status and permitted use before it supports a bounded argument. Authorized action remains a separate responsibility. The diagram is an analytical design, not a claim that a signature or graph proves a physical system safe. Status and profile changes may require reassessment of dependent decisions.
